map_info.name: Facade_NYC_Tenement
map_info.description: The modularized expression of facade assembly. One bay design stacked five storeys, repeated across the width. The grammar reduced to its skeleton: rhythm preserved, column order omitted, hierarchy refused, ornament stripped. What remains is bay × storey, modular, structural, anti-aristocratic.

learning_objectives: Recognise the principle stripped to its repeatable module
Read repetition without hierarchy as a legible compositional choice
Identify what the modular reduction loses and what it gains

map_info.title: The Principle Modularized

documentation.summary: Facade_NYC_Tenement — the principle modularized. One bay × five storeys, repeated.
documentation.layout: 8x6 walkable space. Spawn at back-centre, facing the front wall where the tenement facade composes. Five-storey height allows the vertical repetition to read at scale. Teleporter exit on side.
documentation.objective: Show what the assembly grammar does when stripped to its repeating module. Hierarchy refused, ornament stripped, rhythm reduced to one beat per bay per storey.
key_elements: Five-storey tenement facade on front wall (artifacts queued for pass-3)
Vertical repetition is the lesson — five identical bay-modules stacked
